title: Baked Cod with Velvety Soup
description: A keto-friendly dish featuring cod baked to perfection and served with a rich velvety soup.
instructions: Season the cod fillets with salt and pepper.
Drizzle the Australian olive oil over the cod fillets.
Bake the cod in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the cod is baking, heat the velvety in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add a squeeze of Australian lemon juice to the velvety and stir to combine.
Serve the baked cod with the velvety soup spooned over the top.
